The '''Iron Fist's officers' lounge''' was a room on [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']]. Zsinj would normally play an ambient background sound inside the room, simulating a busy room of people drinking and chatting.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
